evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds .github/ci-guix-test.py to orchestrate unit and functional test runs on Guix-built binaries across native runners.
rationale: The change adds automated execution of functional and unit test suites on release binaries across macOS, Linux, and Windows runners. While worthwhile for verifying release binary behavior, it orchestrates existing test harnesses rather than improving test framework capabilities or fixing flaky tests.
